usedFor: Qminder holds queue visitors, and HubSpot receives a contact when “visitor checks in” runs “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “visitor checks in” in Qminder, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A check-in puts the visitor in HubSpot, and the email match updates a returning contact instead of duplicating it.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” matches by email, so check that “visitor checks in” carries one.
